attributes.name: Candle of Comity
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 1d8 to a character at your location's Charisma or Diplomacy non-combat check.

Bury this card to shuffle the top card of the blessings discard pile into the blessings deck. You may not use this power during an encounter.
